decisions.reason: Black-finish variants follow an ongoing bathroom design trend and extend the core range at little extra cost.
A channel for seamless coverings supports the barrier-free bathroom strategy and is actively promoted on its own page.
The pump-assisted line serves renovation cases, but the newer pump-drain shower channel may partly overlap with it, so the risk of consolidation is somewhat higher.
A tileable floor drain is a standard product close to the firm's core expertise and is cheap to keep in the range.
A stainless steel design grate fits the design-led positioning and the firm's own manufacturing.
The recently launched pump-drain shower channel has its own page and needs time to build sales in renovation and barrier-free applications.
